guides.title: Voice Studio · Create Voices
guides.description: Use Create Voices in Voice Studio.
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.
learning_outcomes: Generate and save one character’s sample

steps.title: Generate and save one character’s sample
steps.body: Choose your checked Creation provider and Add character. Name it and describe a calm, measured voice. Enter Sample text you want to hear; ElevenLabs needs 100–1,000 characters and local accepts 1–5,000. Use the sample-length guidance shown here for each provider before generating. Save selected WAV is the explicit save; use it after listening.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Recover a rejected or slow sample
steps.body: If generation is rejected, read the character’s State or error and correct sample length or provider readiness before retrying. A saved draft keeps names and text but is not a WAV. Draft characters with AI proposes descriptions, not audio. Keep one working reference before attempting a batch.

steps.title: Label and audition the saved recording
steps.body: In Voice Library select the new recording and Play original sample; you should hear the saved candidate. Add a useful Description or Notes such as “calm, low, measured,” then Save details. Select another entry and return to verify the details persisted. Notes do not change the sound.

steps.title: Test an existing recording when speech is ready
steps.body: Generate test needs a loaded compatible Chatterbox backend; selecting a backend alone is insufficient. If it is ready, enter a short test sentence for the selected recording, then use Generate test and Play test. Save test recording exports separately. If speech is not ready, read the related TTS guide later.

steps.title: Check one creation route before starting
steps.body: In Settings choose the route you already have. For ElevenLabs select Use NC ElevenLabs connection or a session-only API key, then Check ElevenLabs connection; generation uses account credits. For local, enter the running service’s loopback URL and Check local connection, confirming a detected engine says loaded. NC does not install that service. Save settings after deliberate edits.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Recover connection errors before creating audio
steps.body: A failed connection is a provider or service state, not a character problem. Resolve it before creating audio. Longer dialogue and temporary cloud voices use credits and are unnecessary for the basic reference exercise. If you try them later, inspect unresolved jobs before allowing a retry, because repeated requests can duplicate spend.
